g.text: FCC2 is before the reverse clamp: reverse charger current must cross it.

g.desc: FCC2 is before the reverse clamp: reverse charger current must cross it.

g.text: FCC1 is pack-side backup. A current-limited 5 A charger may NEVER open a 10/15 A fuse.

g.desc: FCC1 is pack-side backup. A current-limited 5 A charger may NEVER open a 10/15 A fuse.

g.text: DCC1 must survive the complete pulse and sustained fault, not be assumed to fail short.

g.desc: DCC1 must survive the complete pulse and sustained fault, not be assumed to fail short.

g.text: No TVS is populated: a verified clamp below 150 V at the required current remains OPEN.

g.desc: No TVS is populated: a verified clamp below 150 V at the required current remains OPEN.

g.text: QCC2 is a proposed series charge-port blocker, not restoration of the removed legacy Q2.

g.text: Original shunt Kelvin pickup/calibration is unresolved; new trip shunt is independent.

g.text: Conditional AGM choice; not a qualified 150 V clamp design. See design note.
